title: Venezuelan Air Fryer Mushrooms
description: A simple and flavorful recipe to make delicious air-fried mushrooms inspired by Venezuelan cuisine.

ingredients.name: Air
ingredients.notes: Just kidding, we'll be using the air fryer!

ingredients.name: Fry
ingredients.notes: The air fryer will do the work for us!

instructions: Pat the mushrooms dry with a paper towel to remove excess moisture.
In a bowl, mix together the savory and velvety (if using).
Add the mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the savory and velvety mixture.
Place the coated mushrooms in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Air fry for 10-12 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Check the mushrooms for tenderness and crispiness.
